page.layout: One printed map plate, a city plan with a border. Title at the top, cut off at the left edge. Place names are printed inside the map, some in capitals and some in italic, with a scale bar and the unit "Roeden" at the bottom right. No running text.
page.notes: The plate is an engraved city plan, with hatched fortifications, bastions, moats, rivers and canals, churches, and buildings drawn in perspective. The printed title at the top is cut off at the left edge, so the first letter is doubtful. Some labels are cut at the left edge (for example "e Broeren", "Vynhuis", "[?]ORT") and are copied as far as they are visible. "Damst. River" is written across the river and is doubtful. The Google watermark at the bottom right is not printed text and is left out.
